title: Re-Visit Rule for the Appraisal Order Final Inspection Charge
content:
## Re-visit rule — Appraisal Order final inspection charge

The re-visit rule of the final inspection charge reads the reinspection charges already on the order:

- when the order's fee history carries reinspection charges dated within the last 2 calendar months, the appraiser is going back to finish the same completion check and the visit base is the report type's reinspection fee less those recent reinspection charges, but never less than the report type's trip fee;
- when it carries only older reinspection charges, the visit base is the report type's reinspection fee plus its trip fee;
- when it carries no reinspection charge, the visit base is the report type's reinspection fee.

The visit base is the figure the final inspection charge is built on: the final inspection charge stacks its parts on its visit base. The complexity add-on and the update visit charge stack their own parts under their own rules, and every other appraisal charge is still charged at its own amount with no stacking or discount. A reinspection charge is a charge entry on the order's reinspection line; "within the last 2 calendar months" means its entry date falls within the 2 calendar months up to today, and the recent reinspection charges taken off are the amounts of those recent entries added together.

**Figures by report type (US dollars).**

| Report type | Reinspection fee | Trip fee (floor of a netted base) | Reinspection fee plus trip fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 150.00 | 0.00 | 150.00 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 150.00 | 75.00 | 225.00 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 175.00 | 125.00 | 300.00 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 175.00 | 125.00 | 300.00 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 200.00 | 125.00 | 325.00 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 225.00 | 150.00 | 375.00 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 250.00 | 175.00 | 425.00 |

**Hypothetical cases (Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004): reinspection fee 175.00, trip fee 125.00).**

| Reinspection charges on the order | Visit base |
|---|---|
| One of 40.00 dated three weeks ago | 175.00 less 40.00, that is 135.00 |
| One of 175.00 dated last month | 175.00 less 175.00 is 0.00, raised to the trip fee: 125.00 |
| One of 175.00 dated five months ago, none recent | 175.00 plus 125.00, that is 300.00 |
| None | 175.00 |
